name: Solva
long_description: Insurance is 13% of US GDP and we’re building the infrastructure to change how the world handles risk
one_liner: Building the new superintelligence for insurance

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: CEO and Co-founder of Solva. Previously building Lassie to $120M ARR with $120M raised, earning recognition as Europe’s fastest-growing InsurTech. Prior to that, I led AI and machine learning transformations at BCG X across financial services. I also have experience in FinTech and InsurTech from Morgan Stanley

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: COO and Co-founder of Solva. Was previously part of building tech-enabled companies in traditional industries, including KeyTo (from $60m to $250m). Before that, I worked at Citi focusing on InsurTech and at Talentech (formerly ReachMee) with growth and product.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: CTO and Co-founder of Solva. Before Solva, I Co-founded Zaver (most recently starred in CNBC), a European neobank processing over €1 billion annually under an EBA-CRD license. Clients include Porsche, Volkswagen, and Loewe. I've led AI development for leading tech companies long before AI became the norm and my work has been featured in TechCrunch, Bloomberg and Forbes.
